reviews.text: 底子挺好，但是有两个严重问题： 1.玩了三小时，地牢内卡死了三回（画面锁死，声音卡成噪音，只能重开地牢），恶性bug赶紧修. 2.2025年了，这类游戏居然没有平A（no auto attack ？！） 让操作变得无比繁琐，赶紧加上 ———————— 所有职业roll属性建议： 智力低于10一律放弃，越高越好。 战系力敏一高一低，法系高意志低力敏，学识和魅力价值很低。

It's 2025 and another clueless dev team releases a game without gamepad support. Unplayable on ROG Ally, uninstalled and refunded, thanks for wasting my time. Next time spend less on advertisement and more on basic features...
一年前就关注了，超爱这类游戏。体验下来游戏的底子很好，希望制作组能再多加一些地图互动内容，在属性数值和战斗详情方面可以学习一下拥王者和博德之门，例如攻击、防御和命中可以展示加成来自什么装备道具，战斗详情展示攻击时命中投掷的点数和调整值，伤害是怎么计算出来的。
可以看见很多东西的影子，暗黑地牢，神原，DND。 策略深度和游戏随机性是有的，玩起来不会太难也不会太无聊，摸宝的正反馈很足。 就是资源管理这方面有点小小难受，仓库空间有限，优质装备会绑定英雄更换有稀有材料成本。 但总体来说非常好玩上头，发售不到两天已经21小时了。 希望更进更多的内容
我认为不稳定性这个设定十分槽糕，随着等级增加角色不可避免地遭受消失，甚至行动一回合需要两回合来休息，这十分不合理，可以用给角色增加各种DEBUFF来代替，而不是有概率直接让角色消失。（今天作者改过来了，7级也只加35点数，好评！）

It is attached with an AI translation. 总体问题：角色养成极为困难，正反馈随游玩进程推荐而逐步降低，在中期就容易产生厌烦感。 从总体上看，这款角色的大体游玩方式类似于暗黑地牢，通过对角色的招募和养成，在类肉鸽的小副本中获取装备并推进进度，直到解决boss。但在各种机制上安排得并不互相推进，甚至显得有些矛盾。 第一.小副本机制参考了肉鸽爬塔，也就是从底部爬到boss层，副本等级逐渐升高，获取的装备也越来越好。但问题在于通常情况下角色的等级提升跟不上副本等级提升，导致容易翻车，因此需要重回低级副本沉淀。但爬塔是不能走回头路的，也就是说如果你想刷低级本，你本次爬塔进度就得清零重开，再推进一定进度，才能到适合养成的层级。 第二.角色拥有分裂值系统，类暗黑地牢的压力体系，每次下本结算后会逐步累积并在填满后会直接导致角色消失。而分裂值与角色等级挂钩，在角色等级高了以后基本每下一次副本要休息两场副本，我将其视作一种不鼓励高级角色推低级本的一种机制。这又与第一点出现了一定程度上的驳斥，即，如果你要用你的高级队伍刷高级本，那你就得不停重置副本进度，并不停招募低级角色刷低级本推进爬塔进度，在花费大量时间推进爬塔进度后，你的高级队伍在仅进行一两次副本后就必须强行停止否则会有人物分裂值过高的风险。导致中期以后的推塔进度极其重复且单调。 第三点.装备绑定机制。我认为其存在是完全没有必要且负反馈的。我无法理解这种机制的意义在哪里。为什么辛苦获得、附魔获得的装备需要在花费不低的代价以后才能交给其他人？是为了防止中后期低级本推进过于容易吗？可到中后期低级副本本身就没什么作用，其意义只在于获取材料和给高级队伍推进进度垫脚。在辛苦养成后低级副本的难度几乎不变且重复，再结合前两点，更是让强制的低级副本成为让玩家厌恶的存在。 Overall problem: Character cultivation is extremely difficult, and the positive feedback gradually decreases as the gameplay progresses. Players are likely to feel bored in the middle stage. Overall, the general gameplay of this character is similar to Darkest Dungeon. Players recruit and cultivate characters, obtain equipment in roguelike-style small dungeons, and advance the progress until they defeat the boss. However, the various mechanisms are not arranged to mutually promote each other, and even seem somewhat contradictory. First, the mechanism of the small dungeons refers to the roguelike tower climbing, that is, climbing from the bottom to the boss layer. The level of the dungeon gradually increases, and the obtained equipment gets better and better. But the problem is that usually the character's level cannot keep up with the level increase of the dungeon, which makes it easy to fail. Therefore, players need to return to the lower-level dungeons to accumulate experience. However, in tower climbing, there is no way to go back. That is to say, if you want to farm the lower-level dungeons, you have to reset the progress of this tower climbing and start over. Only after advancing a certain amount of progress can you reach the level suitable for character cultivation. Second, the character has a split value system, which is similar to the stress system in Darkest Dungeon. The split value will gradually accumulate after each dungeon run, and when it reaches its maximum, the character will disappear directly. The split value is related to the character's level. After the character's level is high, basically, the character needs to rest for two dungeon runs after each dungeon run. I regard this as a mechanism that discourages high-level characters from farming lower-level dungeons. This also contradicts the first point to a certain extent. That is, if you want to use your high-level team to farm high-level dungeons, you have to keep resetting the dungeon progress and keep recruiting low-level characters to farm low-level dungeons to advance the tower climbing progress. After spending a lot of time advancing the tower climbing progress, your high-level team must be forced to stop after only one or two dungeon runs, otherwise there is a risk of excessive split value for the characters. As a result, the tower climbing progress after the middle stage is extremely repetitive and monotonous. Third, the equipment binding mechanism. I think its existence is completely unnecessary and gives negative feedback. I can't understand the meaning of this mechanism. Why do the equipment obtained through hard work and enchanting need to be given to others at a rather high cost? Is it to prevent the lower-level dungeons from being too easy to clear in the middle and late stages? But in the middle and late stages, the lower-level dungeons themselves have little function, and their significance is only to obtain materials and serve as a stepping stone for the high-level team to advance the progress. After hard cultivation, the difficulty of the lower-level dungeons remains almost the same and is repetitive. Combined with the first two points, it makes the mandatory lower-level dungeons a source of disgust for players.

Do not recommend unfortunately. It's one of those games where even though there is permadeath, you can just keep hiring replacements over and over and over and over. So there's no way to lose. No way to lose = no fun to win. I was going to do a self imposed lose condition, but there's a mechanic in the game that specifically prevents that too. Game seems really good otherwise. I'll be keeping an eye out to see if some sort of lose condition or hardcore mode is added at some point.

[h1][b]奇幻与科幻合而为一的地牢冒险[/b][/h1] 《Escape The Mad Empire》是一款像素Rogue冒险游戏，主打地牢探索，玩家将操控一支小队穿越各个维度的地下城，搜刮宝藏并伺机撤离。 游戏分为基地建设和地牢冒险两部分。 作为一款奇幻风游戏，本作的基地看起来却极具科幻感，玩家将在一个电子AI的引导下学习各类设施的使用。 基地中布满了可供建造的空位，玩家可选择在其中建造招募角色用的灵魂提取器、商店储存二合一的随即复制器等物，此外角色还可在基地里获得升级。 本作打造了一个类似于《杀戮尖塔》的分支地图，上面布满了各个冒险节点，鼠标悬浮上去可查阅相关信息，按需选择即可。 每个地下城的地形都是随机生成的，里面布满了房间、宝藏、陷阱以及敌人，并且有战争迷雾的保护，需要玩家操控小队仔细探索，搜刮宝藏的同时处理掉威胁，并找到钥匙逃出生天。 游戏中玩家可同时控制多个角色，这些角色拥有不同的职业和属性，玩家可按其风格配置装备。 战斗中角色可以切换使用两把主武器，还能使用技能辅助作战，诸如推击、治疗等。 此外还可以远程击破炸药桶、毒素桶等陷阱创造优势，或是使用卷轴、药水等道具。 因为操控多个角色的原因，战斗经常会出现手忙脚乱的情况，游戏设计了一个随时可用的暂停系统，按下空格触发暂停后再做相关命令也不迟。 整体来说本作的体验还不错，硬核的操作加上流行的Rogue玩法，玩起来也是很有感觉，目前游戏还在抢先体验阶段，期待后续更新。 [quote] 亲亲亲！亲亲亲！噗铃噗铃！爱你爱你！姆尼姆尼！叻咯叻咯！姆拉姆拉！[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44515001]不动不动不动卿[/url]亲亲亲！亲亲亲！爱你爱你！姆尼姆尼！噗铃噗铃！波隆奴璐璐！叻咯叻咯！ [/quote]

[h1] 像素紫色晶石+博德之门[/h1] [h3] 游戏介绍[/h3] 本作是一款像素风格的游戏，在游戏的玩法上我看到了很多其他优秀游戏的影子，有着很多的DND要素，就像是像素版的《博德之门》+《紫色晶石》的结合。 [h3] 游戏玩法[/h3] 游戏的操作是类似于crpg的半即时制。玩家在面临时需要频繁使用暂停，然后规划小队的每个人的任务，选择每个人平a的对象和释放技能的对象。在击杀敌人或技能冷却转好之后再次暂停选择使用的对象。而且游戏中有着丰富的场景互动要素，场景中是有着油桶，毒桶，水桶等等可破坏的物品的，若是先把油桶打爆，在地上铺上一层油，在油上放火那一片就会烧起来，而附近若是有水桶打爆可以灭火。 游戏中的人物有着几项能量条一样的条，最上面是口渴度，下面是饱食度，最下面是经验值，而游戏人物的血量则是在游戏人物头像显示，没受伤情况下头像是正常的，而受伤之后头像的一部分会变红，而在篝火处可以消耗饱食度来回血。此外游戏中没有魔法值的设定，而是用了技能位的设定。每次升级可以在几个技能中选择一项，而技能在每次下副本的时候有着最大使用次数。不过游戏中的装备有的词条可以让技能使用次数增加，或是给你一个新的技能。 [h3] 游戏的一些问题[/h3] 1.游戏升级好像不加属性，额外属性只能通过装备来提供，而且游戏中的属性检定事件成功了只加经验值。而且游戏中不管是物理职业还是魔法职业，他们的技能伤害都是和智力这个属性挂钩的，感觉不太好，应该做出区分。 2. 游戏中有着一套叫做不稳定值的设定，如果你经常使用一个角色，它的不稳定值就会增加很多，而高不稳定值有可能使它下一次副本之后几个副本不能出战。特别高的不稳定值有可能使这个角色直接消失。我清楚这是游戏想让玩家使用灵魂提取器来体验不同的角色，但是这应该是建议玩家去使用，而不是强制把这个角色消除了，去让玩家尝试其他不同角色。 3. 哪怕我是5个人一起下副本，我的背包也就那么大。但这可能是资源管理的一部分，我就暂且不提，可是家里基地仓库的格子太小了，我打通一次完整的副本把东西都带回来，或是在商店买几件武器，家里的格子就塞满了。 [quote]关注：「[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45549554/]慕之安鉴赏组」[/url]，慕赏游韵，安品游情[/quote] [u][b]“慕之安鉴赏组”静候同路人。[/b][/u]
One of the best party based dungeon crawlers out right now.

目前在第一大关，感觉难度偏低，随机性太小，每关钥匙都是固定有，根本不需要暴力开锁这个东西。 搜打撤的玩法根本体现不出，因为没有时间限制，基本全图都能探索，又因为钥匙固定，导致根本没有发现宝箱却没有钥匙的懊悔感与是否要暴力开锁的抉择，前几张图的新鲜感在前期就消失殆尽，装备绑定也是神人系统，因为游戏是类似暗黑地牢的需要更换人物的2玩法就导致找到的装备还不能给一个人用，一般游戏找到好装备就穿上在这化为了选择困难症烂在包里。 卷轴也是不明所以的系统，低等级本不需要，高等级本又不会常备卷轴（因为有其他更重要的东西要带），导致非常鸡肋。 制作组想法不错，想缝合一个好玩的搜打撤加暗黑地牢游戏，然而缝合的不太好，游戏体验较差。 价格68贵了，在我看来不值得。 目前是EA版本，等后续更新正式版（如果有的话）再看。

There's a lot to enjoy in this game but on balance I give it the thumbs down because there's too much metaprogression/the base management side doesn't really support the actual meat of the experience, which is dungeon delving. I should reiterate the the core gameplay of taking a team into a dungeon for an extended conflict with monsters and bosses is solidly executed, but the base management, unlocking classes, and metaprogression feel bloated to the point of padding.

此游戏为半即时制类dnd选关游戏，这个品类现在有新游戏实在少见，本应该支持。 但是游戏有诸多故意延长垃圾时间的设定，游戏内容不足，却希望用这种方式掩盖，又消耗玩家时间，本就少的内容还体验不完。 游戏内的大关卡可以随时无条件刷新，小关卡有一个词条，但无明显区别，随着等级升高，玩家雇佣的角色完成关卡后会添加不稳定值，不稳定值拉满就会有不好的事情发生，强制要求你用低级角色，就不让你畅快地体验游戏内容。 游戏内虽然有多种职业，但是高级职业解锁需要的资源非常难积累，又是故意延长玩家垃圾时间。 装备会绑定第一个使用者，解除绑定需要分解最高品质的装备给的材料，而地城里因为背包容量有限，有时候不得不把不需要的装备给有空位的角色穿，还是延长玩家时间的无意义操作。 游戏内有饮水和饥饿值，这本该成为调剂，但是玩家需要消耗背包资源和金币买食物，且回到基地后饥饿值并不会回复，这是一个长期折磨的行为，玩家需要一直关注这个和gameplay基本无关的琐事；且只有我方有饥渴值，敌人没有，哪怕你出一个能把敌人饿死的法术，我都不会对饥渴值的设定那么反感，这是纯粹折磨玩家。 本游戏的属性过于不平衡。 力量：影响重甲的物理护盾值，所有武器的伤害，力量武器的命中。 敏捷：影响轻甲的AC，敏捷武器的命中。 体质：影响血。 智力：影响所有技能伤害（包括纯物理职业），8智力-30%，13智力-5%，15智力+5%，影响升级获得的改进技能的研习点。 意志：影响魔法攻击的命中，影响被魔法攻击的AC，影响物理护盾，影响法术护盾。 学识：影响回复能量速度（战斗中使用消耗品会扣除能量） 魅力：影响雇佣？ 可以看出这个属性系统，敏捷、学识过于无用，哪怕变成0都没有多大影响。力量对菜刀刚需，意志对法系刚需，智力、体质大家都需要。

I want to like this game so badly. The idea of a dungeon crawling, party based, roguelite experience sounds awesome, but the game ends up feeling unsatisfying, unfinished, and the core gameplay loop feels like a chore. The combat system feels like its having an identity crisis. You control a party of 5 characters in real time sort of similar to the way you control units in an RTS game. But you additionally have the ability to freeze time whenever you want and select characters to cast specific spells and use special attacks, and these happen instantaneously while time is still frozen. The result is really really awkward. youre constantly unpausing for a quarter of a second to let your characters run into range of an enemy, pausing to use spells and abilities, then unpausing for another half second while you need to reposition slightly, then unpausing to let your characters finish off an enemy, then pausing again to select a new target for each of your characters etc... It just doesnt feel smooth in the slightest. Its difficult to tell what enemy each character is targeting or where they are going, and damage happens quick enough that unpausing for more than 2 seconds might result in one of your characters getting killed so you constantly need to pause just to make sure everyone is healthy. Its essentially a tactical turn based rpg but everything takes its turn at once and the turns last half a second. I wouldve loved more familiar turn based tactical combat but the current system is a slow, cluttered mess that makes me feel disappointed everytime i have to enter combat. Aside from core gameplay loop, theres lots of smaller issues that just make it frustrating. Like your equipment permanently binds to a character on equip, so once one guys uses a sword, no other character can use it. HALF of the classes require you to sacrifice a high leveled character in order to buy which feels super bad and i cant understand what the thought process behind this mechanic was. Additionally, the character stat system just doesnt make much sense. For example, intelligence scales the damage of ALL spells and abilities. This means every character class no matter what always needs intelligence, even a big strong melee guy whose abilities are just hitting things. Then they have charisma listed on the character sheet but its a completely irrelevant stat that doesnt even actually exist, its just the average of two other stats so i guess its just there to confuse you. Its a system that's just needlessly unintuitive and frustrating. To top it all off, the updates seem to come in VERY slow, and arent addressing big issues and bugs. For example, I came back to give the game another try upon seeing they released an update for the first time in months, and in my second dungeon i got soft locked because i teleported across a pit to fight a boss and there just wasnt any way to go back after killing it. Theres also a ton of things to build in your base for meta progression that arent available yet. After MONTHS of no updates, the only meta progression building they added was a way to upgrade inventory space, so im not optimistic about the release of more complicated mechanics. I really want to like this game, but i just cant. I could forgive the combat system if the rest of the game was complete and clean, or i could forgive the unpolished systems and bugs if the combat was awesome, but it just doesnt have either. I hope to be proven wrong because the idea of this game is so awesome, but i don't really see a world where these issues get fixed or the game actually feels finished.

光看展示视频其实对游戏还蛮期待的。但随实际上手以后觉得还是没法给好评。 When I watch the video of game on steam, I am quite expected something great. But after I actually play it, I feel quite hard to give it a positive rate. 能看得出制作者并没有敷衍，但是游戏最大的问题是 它并不好玩。是的，你有比较惊奇的装备系统，符文，附魔等,人物属性设计的很全面，暗黑2+dnd那味真的不能再正了，但是 如果每场战斗都是 我的五个小人儿 普通攻击 围殴一个血量巨不平衡的首领，不停的触发各种由符文/特效带来的控制使 对方无法输出（因为对方输出一两下你就会倒一个人），那么所有的系统设计在最后都没有办法带来正反馈。 I can see that the developer definitely spending a tremendous amount of time of coding, but the problem is these system is not fun at all. Yes, you have an amazing equipment system like Diablo II, including Enchant etc. And yes the character attribute follows DND. But if every single tough battle in the end is five team members you controlled using normal attack triggering all kinds of hard crowd controls brought by enchantment towards a leader enemy (not even a boss) with unbalanced large health, there is no system can be fun in the end. (And you are forced to designed your team that way since once you allow enemy free one-two turns, one of your members will down) 这个游戏的各个系统目前 都是极度割裂的。没有任何1+1>2的。比如附魔，同一个词条，武器被附魔还是装甲被附魔效果 是一样的，它只是一个割裂的凑词条的系统。比如鉴定，放鉴定台里要等3回合，也可以直接用鉴定卷轴，但是本质都是 非常简单朴素 为难玩家的基础资源管理（无聊透了）。类似的 在我看来 减法会比加法更好的 地方有很多，虽然 制作组绝对花了很多心思在这些加法开发上，但还是希望制作组合理评估一下，目前的战斗系统以及游戏内容 太肤浅了， 根本撑不起 你的这些可有可无，看起来很棒，但是起不到正反馈的附属系统。 The mechanism of this game is so isolated. There is no mutual interaction at all. For instance, the same enchantment makes no difference for whether it is on your weapon or your armor, it is just an isolated system, just get enough enchantment no matter where, it all plays the same effect. Another example is identify items. Choosing between using an identify scroll or spending money directly but waiting for 3 turns of dungeons is super boring, just some unnecessary mechanism to challenge basic resource control. Simple is better than complicated for this game. Even though the developer has definitely spending a lot of time designing these "unnecessary" mechanism, I hope when they have time, take a look and measure it more carefully: At current stage, the shallow content of your battle design and game story can not afford to have such huge auxiliary subsystems. 如果以目前的游戏完成度，我觉得它的好评率应该在75-80%左右会比较合理。 Given the current degree of completion as a game, I will say a good rate of 70-80% will be reasonable fair result. 也并不推荐购买，因为我感觉 制作组有点陷入死胡同了。 And not recommending buy, since I can see many dead ends the developer is stepping into.

一个基于DND背景的搜打撤，技能配置还算有趣，搞不清楚敌人很可能翻车团灭，但熟悉敌人后，难度有点偏低。攻击力（在这个游戏中是命中，没玩过dnd的玩家可能被坑）重要性远大于输出伤害，最后boss的DC有44，非常吓人。 百夫长我的超人，力量（*1.5）+ 命中50伤害加成（*1.5） + 无人能挡（*1.5）+ 彻底狂乱（*1.8）这几个buff居然全部是乘 算只需要带攻击力（命中词条）就可以获得远超其他职业带一堆武器骰子或者技能骰子的输出效果。完全可以做到35不稳定度内，命中25（用来打巫妖和吸血鬼）的一个build，并且频繁攻击配合命中回复技能（技能不要钱）和命中眩晕（这个可能需要刷一下，或者用两个命中群体眩晕代替）集输出，扛伤，控制于一身。 另外现在版本bug比较多，比如可以通过弓箭或者卷轴这类可堆叠的物品在商店刷钱 以及，可以通过，黑骑士的+体质技能，卡buff时间与吸血鬼变鸡时间，实现刷血量，养一个几千血的血牛，然后使用复仇技能，回复全部血量并且造成已损失生命值的伤害（但输出效率仍然不敌百夫长） 现在潜行buff不能暴击buff了，我觉得这挺可惜的 牧师的燃烧之光符文看上去很拉跨，但实际上因为可以吃到技能基础加成和一系列骰子加成，配合高频大范围攻击，以及不吃法术攻击，实际上现在是少数能拿得出手的输出法术（控制法术也就是群体沉默，高难度下法术的输出量都不够看），但也有bug，可能会烧死队友和自己 期待最贵的法师在远征中的表现，不然真的跟帝国禁卫坐一桌了

I like this game. I'm not sure there's really anything else like it--is it a dungeon crawler or a roguelike? Kinda both? The game can be as challenging or as easy as you want it to be. Combat is like Baldur's Gate 1&2, which works really well. Depending on the difficulty, the battles can be pleasantly challenging. There's a lot of room to get creative with different spell combinations (cast fireball, then put the enemies to sleep...in the flames!) Each class is pretty fun and they all offer some unique helpful ability you'll be missing each run. The dungeons can get a little repetitive; I wish that there were more monsters that were unique to different biomes, or at least their abilities were more unique.
